# repository must be registered to inspect

kc inspect checks that the repository slug is registered in the database and raises a ClickException instructing the user to run kc init if the repository row is missing.

Prevent attempts to inspect state for repositories not present in storage and guide users to perform repository registration first.

- `knowledge_compiler/cli.py` — `knowledge_compiler.cli.inspect_cmd`
